basics.name: Paul Schulte
basics.label: M.Sc. Computer Science Student
basics.summary: M.Sc. Computer Science student at RWTH Aachen University focusing on machine learning, optimization, algorithms, and graph theory. Research experience includes self-supervised learning of discrete relational structures from image sequences and safety-critical trajectory planning.

work.name: RWTH Aachen University, Chair for Machine Learning and Inference (i6)
work.summary: Researching self-supervised learning of discrete relational structures from image sequences.
highlights: Extended thesis work on dynamic scene graph generation for action classification
Equal-contribution first author of an oral GenPlan Workshop paper at ICAPS 2026

work.name: Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
work.summary: Worked on safety-critical trajectory planning for interactive traffic safety.
highlights: Developed an MPC framework with Control Barrier Functions for safety-critical trajectory planning
Implemented real-time planning in JAX for CPU-based F1TENTH hardware, reducing reliance on GPU-heavy approaches
Co-authored the USDOT/Safety21 final report Risk-Aware Warning and Control for Interactive Traffic Safety

work.name: Siemens Logistics
work.summary: Designed and implemented C# features for an airport baggage handling system planning tool.
highlights: Optimized computationally intensive planning components, reducing runtime by up to 80%

courses: Dean's List: top 5% of cohort across all semesters
